title: Liguria's Pump Prices Keep Creeping Up — And Diesel Is Leading the Way
dek: Self-service Benzina and Gasolio in Liguria both sit above the national average, with diesel notching its steepest one-day rise in a week.
body: In Liguria, self-service Benzina is averaging €2.0185 per liter and Gasolio €2.1311 as of August 18, 2026 — both a touch above the national self-service averages of €2.0071 and €2.1289. The Benzina gap is the more visible one, with Liguria running about 1.1 cents above the rest of Italy, while diesel is essentially neck-and-neck with the national figure.

The trend over the past week has been gently upward on both fuels: Benzina self-service climbed from €2.0116 to €2.0185 and Gasolio from €2.1079 to €2.1311, with diesel's biggest single-day jump of the week landing right on the most recent reading. Liguria has 539 registered stations, of which 487 reported prices on the latest count — a reporting rate of roughly 90%, in line with the network activity seen through the rest of August.
